discovery_notes: All claims are search snippets only. DPB monthly roundups give only themes: Feb 2018 Toy Story/Tangled/Lion King; Mar St Patrick's/Peter Pan/princess, PTN 30 Mar; Jun Marvel/Incredibles 2/princess; Jul PTN 27 Jul; Dec Peter Pan/Inside Out/Mulan. No pins recorded for those (no names). Travel to the Magic Feb/Mar/Apr 2018 posts embed PDF schedules not readable in snippets (Apr: pin event 28 Apr, Pueblo Trading Post). Easter 2018 Cheshire Cat LE 700 seen only on a resale listing - not recorded. Lion King Tresors de DLP LE 400 (disneystore.eu) undated - not recorded. Halloween/Christmas 2018 DLP LE sets, CM 2018 pin, Marvel season pins not found. My Pin Central 1299/46382 show PTD Stitch/Mickey but mapping unclear - not used. Pocket Parks LE 1500 $34.99 in March snippet looks US-sourced - not recorded.
